responsibility: This file implements the low-level fixed-buffer command-line argument interface for GNU Modula-2 programs in the mc-boot runtime. It bridges the runtime's UnixArgs argv/argc storage to Modula-2 callers by copying the nth argument into a caller-supplied character array and reporting the total argument count, making it the array-based companion to the dynamic-string argument wrappers elsewhere in the module.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Args pair: unlike GArgs.h's declarations-only interface, this file contains the executable bridge to `GUnixArgs`, copying argv entries into caller buffers and returning the runtime argument count.
